_comment: Gudauri corrections. IDS ARE FROM THE CURRENT `npm run data` BUILD; `data:refresh` renumbers nodes and will break these. (1) 'Frini' blue piste reversal: the top/north endpoint n37 (42.5111, 44.4929), which is really the ~2951 m summit hub next to n100 (13 m away, correctly 2951 m) and where the Frini run's own polyline peaks at 2951 m, was DEM-sampled at 2698 m. That false low made the 2.4 km Frini piste orient south->north (uphill) and pushed the short Kobi top link n37->n100 uphill too. It slipped past the global pothole repair because n37 is a piste_endpoint whose only piste-way neighbour is the low n99 (the n37->n100 Kobi link is an inferred 8 m connector), so it read as a genuine run end. Set n37 to 2951 m so Frini descends north->south and Kobi's top stays level. (2) DEM cross-check (`npm run check:elevation`) + map verification: the n23->n46 arrows ran uphill. n46 is really ~2840 m and n23 ~2826 m, so that link descends n46->n23. n23 is the shared bottom of the n86 and n46 runs and sits only ~42 m from the 2813 m lift-station cluster (n61/n90/n47/n8), but OSM has no way joining them, so correcting the elevations left n23 with no exit. Add the missing short ski-out n23->n61 (~13 m drop over ~42 m) that the old, too-high n23 elevation had been masking.
